---
format:
  typst: default
---

```{=typst}
#let navy = rgb("#1E2B55")
#let charcoal = rgb("#20262D")
#let slate = rgb("#596673")
#let mist = rgb("#D9DEE2")
#let sail = rgb("#F4F5F6")
#let pcss-gold = rgb("#F4C91D")

#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  flipped: true,
  margin: (top: 0.28in, bottom: 0.48in, x: 0.42in),
  footer: context [
    #set text(
      font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
      size: 6.5pt,
      fill: slate,
      hyphenate: false,
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 12pt,
      [#link("https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/")[#text(fill: navy)[CC BY 4.0]] - share and adapt with attribution to Andrew Andrade: #link("https://github.com/mrandrewandrade")[#text(fill: navy)[https://github.com/mrandrewandrade]]],
      [Page #counter(page).display("1 of 1", both: true)]
    )
  ]
)

#set text(font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"), size: 8.3pt, fill: charcoal, hyphenate: false)
#set par(leading: 0.46em, justify: false)

#let blank-field(label) = [
  #text(weight: "bold")[#label:]
  #h(5pt)
  #line(length: 1.8in, stroke: 0.55pt + slate)
]

#let identity-fields = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
    column-gutter: 14pt,
    [#blank-field("Name")],
    [#blank-field("Class")],
    [#blank-field("Date")],
  )
]

#let notes-header(side) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    align: horizon,
    [
      #text(size: 20pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[0.2 The Way We Meet - Listening Notes]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 8.6pt, fill: slate)[Attention, connection, and making space for one another - #side]
    ],
    [#text(size: 7.6pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons · Port Credit Secondary School]]
  )
  #v(3pt)
  #line(length: 0.58in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
  #v(2pt)
  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.2pt + navy)
  #v(4pt)
  #identity-fields
  #v(4pt)
  #block(
    width: 100%,
    fill: sail,
    stroke: (left: 3pt + pcss-gold),
    inset: (left: 8pt, right: 8pt, top: 4pt, bottom: 4pt),
  )[
    #text(size: 7.7pt)[Make space for each speaker: phones away unless directed otherwise, face the speaker, avoid side conversations, and write one brief note for every presenter. Circle #text(weight: "bold")[A] = Attentive, #text(weight: "bold")[S] = Some lapses, or #text(weight: "bold")[N] = Not attentive. Be honest: an honest S or N is better than a false A. After the final presentation, complete the two reflection pages.]
  ]
  #v(5pt)
]

#let reflection-header(title, subtitle) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    align: horizon,
    [
      #text(size: 20pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#title]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 8.6pt, fill: slate)[#subtitle]
    ],
    [#text(size: 7.6pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons · Port Credit Secondary School]]
  )
  #v(3pt)
  #line(length: 0.58in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
  #v(2pt)
  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.2pt + navy)
  #v(4pt)
  #identity-fields
  #v(6pt)
]

#let notes-table(start, end, pad) = table(
  columns: (0.36in, 1.42in, 6.52in, 1.42in),
  inset: (x: 4pt, y: pad),
  stroke: 0.55pt + mist,
  align: left + top,
  table.header(
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[No.]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Presenter]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Listening note / connection / question / comment]],
    [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[My attention]] #linebreak() #align(center)[#text(size: 7pt, fill: slate)[A / S / N]]],
  ),
  ..range(start, end + 1).map(n => (
    [#n], [], [], [#align(center)[A / S / N]],
  )).flatten()
)

#let response-box(prompt, height: 0.85in) = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: height,
  stroke: 0.55pt + mist,
  inset: 6pt,
  [#text(size: 7.2pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[#prompt]]
)

#notes-header([Page 1 - Presenters 1-17])
#notes-table(1, 17, 6.0pt)

#pagebreak()
#notes-header([Page 2 - Presenters 18-34])
#notes-table(18, 34, 6.0pt)

#pagebreak()
#reflection-header(
  [0.2 The Way We Meet - Listening Reflection],
  [Evaluate how you listened, how you handled lapses, and what you will do next time.],
)

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 16pt,
  [
    #text(size: 10.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Listening self-evaluation - use evidence]
    #v(2pt)
    #text(size: 7pt, fill: slate)[Score each area, then write what you actually did. If it was not strong, write what you will do differently next time.]
    #v(3pt)
    #table(
      columns: (1.65in, 0.43in, 1fr),
      inset: (x: 3pt, y: 3pt),
      stroke: 0.45pt + mist,
      [#text(size: 6.8pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Area]], [#text(size: 6.8pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[/2]], [#text(size: 6.8pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[My evidence / next step]],
      [#text(size: 6.5pt, weight: "bold")[Attention & Presence] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.1pt, fill: slate)[phone away, face speaker, avoid side talk, refocus]], [#line(length: 0.24in, stroke: 0.45pt + slate)], [#v(9pt)],
      [#text(size: 6.5pt, weight: "bold")[Audience Notes] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.1pt, fill: slate)[specific note for each presenter]], [#line(length: 0.24in, stroke: 0.45pt + slate)], [#v(9pt)],
      [#text(size: 6.5pt, weight: "bold")[Discussion & Connections] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.1pt, fill: slate)[questions, comments, or connections]], [#line(length: 0.24in, stroke: 0.45pt + slate)], [#v(9pt)],
      [#text(size: 6.5pt, weight: "bold")[Completion & Consistency] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.1pt, fill: slate)[kept up across all four pages]], [#line(length: 0.24in, stroke: 0.45pt + slate)], [#v(9pt)],
      [#text(size: 6.5pt, weight: "bold")[Integrity & Reflection] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.1pt, fill: slate)[honest ratings and thoughtful reflection]], [#line(length: 0.24in, stroke: 0.45pt + slate)], [#v(9pt)],
    )
    #v(2pt)
    #text(size: 7.4pt, weight: "bold")[My listening total: ] #line(length: 0.42in, stroke: 0.55pt + slate) #text(size: 7.4pt, weight: "bold")[ /10]
  ],
  [
    #text(size: 10.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Learning Skills self-evaluation]
    #v(2pt)
    #text(size: 7pt, fill: slate)[Circle C = Consistently, S = Sometimes, or N = Not yet. Give evidence of what you did or a specific next step.]
    #v(3pt)
    #table(
      columns: (1.48in, 0.54in, 1fr),
      inset: (x: 3pt, y: 2.6pt),
      stroke: 0.45pt + mist,
      [#text(size: 6.8pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Skill]], [#text(size: 6.8pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[C / S / N]], [#text(size: 6.8pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[My evidence / next step]],
      [#text(size: 6.4pt, weight: "bold")[Responsibility] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.0pt, fill: slate)[prepared, phone away, completed/submitted]], [C / S / N], [#v(7pt)],
      [#text(size: 6.4pt, weight: "bold")[Organization] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.0pt, fill: slate)[notes complete, readable, in order]], [C / S / N], [#v(7pt)],
      [#text(size: 6.4pt, weight: "bold")[Independent Work] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.0pt, fill: slate)[worked without repeated reminders]], [C / S / N], [#v(7pt)],
      [#text(size: 6.4pt, weight: "bold")[Collaboration] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.0pt, fill: slate)[respectful audience; supported speakers]], [C / S / N], [#v(7pt)],
      [#text(size: 6.4pt, weight: "bold")[Initiative] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.0pt, fill: slate)[offered a question, comment, or connection]], [C / S / N], [#v(7pt)],
      [#text(size: 6.4pt, weight: "bold")[Self-Regulation] #linebreak() #text(size: 6.0pt, fill: slate)[managed distractions and refocused]], [C / S / N], [#v(7pt)],
    )
  ],
)

#v(8pt)
#text(size: 11pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Listening reflection - write in your own words]
#v(3pt)
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 12pt,
  [#response-box([When was I most attentive? What did I do that helped me listen?], height: 1.0in)],
  [#response-box([Where did my attention slip, or where did I need a reminder? What happened?], height: 1.0in)],
  [#response-box([What is one specific thing I will do next time to be a better listener and audience member?], height: 1.0in)],
)

#pagebreak()
#reflection-header(
  [0.2 The Way We Meet - Presentation Reflection & Submission],
  [Compare your 0.1 presentation with what you learned from watching and listening to classmates.],
)

#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: sail,
  stroke: (left: 3pt + pcss-gold),
  inset: (left: 9pt, right: 9pt, top: 5pt, bottom: 5pt),
)[
  #text(size: 9pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[This is a reflection, not a re-mark.] #text(size: 8pt)[After seeing other approaches, reconsider what worked in your own 0.1 Past, Present & Becoming presentation and what you would do differently next time.]
]

#v(6pt)
#text(size: 10.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Re-score my 0.1 presentation after hearing the class]
#v(3pt)
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr, 1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 8pt,
  [#text(size: 7pt, weight: "bold")[Knowledge] #linebreak() #line(length: 0.34in, stroke: 0.45pt + slate) /2],
  [#text(size: 7pt, weight: "bold")[Thinking] #linebreak() #line(length: 0.34in, stroke: 0.45pt + slate) /2],
  [#text(size: 7pt, weight: "bold")[Communication] #linebreak() #line(length: 0.34in, stroke: 0.45pt + slate) /2],
  [#text(size: 7pt, weight: "bold")[Visuals & access.] #linebreak() #line(length: 0.34in, stroke: 0.45pt + slate) /2],
  [#text(size: 7pt, weight: "bold")[Application] #linebreak() #line(length: 0.34in, stroke: 0.45pt + slate) /2],
  [#text(size: 7pt, weight: "bold")[Total] #linebreak() #line(length: 0.40in, stroke: 0.45pt + slate) /10],
)

#v(8pt)
#text(size: 11pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Presentation reflection - compare, do not just score]
#v(3pt)
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 12pt,
  row-gutter: 10pt,
  [#response-box([After hearing others, what is one part of my own presentation that I still think was effective? Why?], height: 1.05in)],
  [#response-box([Describe one specific thing another presenter did effectively. Why did it work for the audience?], height: 1.05in)],
  [#response-box([Compared with what I saw and heard, what is one part of my presentation I would change? Why?], height: 1.05in)],
  [#response-box([What is one specific thing I will do differently in my next presentation?], height: 1.05in)],
)

#v(8pt)
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 12pt,
  [#response-box([Activity feedback: What helped you listen, connect, or learn from other people?], height: 0.72in)],
  [#response-box([Improve it next time: What should change to make this activity better?], height: 0.72in)],
)

#v(7pt)
#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: sail,
  stroke: (left: 3pt + navy),
  inset: (left: 8pt, right: 8pt, top: 4pt, bottom: 4pt),
)[
  #text(size: 7.1pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Submit one PDF to Google Classroom.] #text(size: 7.1pt)[Digital: complete the editable Word file in Word, or upload it to Google Drive and open it with Google Docs, then download/export as PDF. Paper: scan these pages directly to PDF, or take clear photos, place them in a Google Doc or Word file in the correct order, then export as PDF. Open the PDF and check that all #text(weight: "bold")[four pages] are readable, upright, complete, and in order. Do not submit separate images.]
]
```
